subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3 i.e. Picth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's explore the options:
 
• **Stingy** means not generous, unwilling to give, especially money. (कंजूस)
 
• **Culminate** means to reach a final result. (समापन)
 
• **Hasty** means (used about a person) acting or deciding something too quickly or without enough thought. (जल्दबाजी भरा)
 
• The is no such word as "Picth".
 
• The correct spelling is **Pitch** which means the quality of a sound governed by the rate of vibrations producing it; the degree of highness or lowness of a tone. (आवाज़ का उतार-चढ़ाव)
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**
